answer: One defense is stake-backed reputation that decays like an ivory tower slowly losing its shine unless its owner keeps doing verified work. Each agent locks a deposit; peers attest its trades, and a random audit samples its history against an ocean of past transactions — a fake that copies one identity's behavior across many accounts stands out as a correlated nebula of clones. Cheating forfeits the stake and burns the reputation, so each sybil costs real money and time, not just a free signup.
